user.title: Connect to Elering Estfeed
user.description: Create an API key in the [Estfeed portal]({portal_url}) and enter its credentials below. The credentials are only sent to Elering.

data_description.client_id: The UUID shown for your API key in the Estfeed portal.
data_description.client_secret: Shown when the API key is created. Kept only in your Home Assistant configuration and sent only to Elering's login service.
data_description.friendly_name: Used in entity and statistic IDs, e.g. "Home" → estfeed:home_consumption_…. Cannot be changed later without losing history.

pricing.title: Electricity price
pricing.description:
Costs are calculated from the hourly Nord Pool spot price for Estonia:

**Cost** = (spot + margin) × (1 + VAT)
**Compensation** = (spot − production fee) × (1 + VAT if enabled)

You can change these later under **Configure**.

data.margin_eur_per_kwh: Seller margin and other per-kWh charges (excl. VAT)
data.production_fee_eur_per_kwh: Production fee deducted by the buyer (excl. VAT)

data_description.vat_mode: The Estonian schedule applies the rate in force on each day (20% until 2023, 22% in 2024 – June 2025, 24% from 1 July 2025), so imported history is priced correctly.
data_description.vat_percent: Used only when the VAT rate is set to a custom value.
data_description.margin_eur_per_kwh: Added to the Nord Pool spot price before VAT. Example: 0.0050 EUR/kWh = 0.5 cents/kWh. You can include network fees here if they are a flat per-kWh rate. Negative values are allowed.
data_description.production_vat: Leave off unless you are VAT-registered and your electricity buyer pays you VAT on sold energy. Most households are not.
data_description.production_fee_eur_per_kwh: Subtracted from the spot price for energy you sell to the grid. Example: 0.0030 EUR/kWh = 0.3 cents/kWh.
data_description.backfill_months: Imported in the background after setup (1–84 months, 30 days each).

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Estfeed
reauth_confirm.description: The API key for **{name}** was rejected. Enter a valid key from the [Estfeed portal]({portal_url}).

data_description.client_id: The UUID shown for your API key in the Estfeed portal.
data_description.client_secret: Shown when the API key is created. Kept only in your Home Assistant configuration and sent only to Elering's login service.

reconfigure.title: Change API key
reconfigure.description: Enter new API credentials for **{name}** from the [Estfeed portal]({portal_url}). History and entities are kept.

data_description.client_id: The UUID shown for your API key in the Estfeed portal.
data_description.client_secret: Shown when the API key is created. Kept only in your Home Assistant configuration and sent only to Elering's login service.

error.invalid_auth: Elering's login service rejected this client ID and secret. Check that you copied the whole secret, that the ID and secret are not swapped, and that the key is still active in the Estfeed portal. The Home Assistant log shows Elering's reason.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Estfeed API. Try again later.
error.slug_in_use: Another Estfeed installation already uses this name.
error.already_configured: This API key is already used by another Estfeed installation.
error.no_access: Elering accepted the API key but refused access to metering data. Check in the Estfeed portal that the key is active and has access to your metering points. The Home Assistant log shows Elering's reason.

abort.already_configured: This API key is already configured.

init.title: Estfeed options
init.description:
**Cost** = (spot + margin) × (1 + VAT)
**Compensation** = (spot − production fee) × (1 + VAT if enabled)

Changing a price setting recalculates the cost statistics for the history window in the background.

data.margin_eur_per_kwh: Seller margin and other per-kWh charges (excl. VAT)
data.production_fee_eur_per_kwh: Production fee deducted by the buyer (excl. VAT)

data_description.vat_mode: The Estonian schedule applies the rate in force on each day (20% until 2023, 22% in 2024 – June 2025, 24% from 1 July 2025), so imported history is priced correctly.
data_description.vat_percent: Used only when the VAT rate is set to a custom value.
data_description.margin_eur_per_kwh: Added to the Nord Pool spot price before VAT. Example: 0.0050 EUR/kWh = 0.5 cents/kWh. You can include network fees here if they are a flat per-kWh rate. Negative values are allowed.
data_description.production_vat: Leave off unless you are VAT-registered and your electricity buyer pays you VAT on sold energy. Most households are not.
data_description.production_fee_eur_per_kwh: Subtracted from the spot price for energy you sell to the grid. Example: 0.0030 EUR/kWh = 0.3 cents/kWh.
data_description.backfill_months: Window used when recalculating costs. Use the backfill action to import more history.
data_description.resolution: Hourly is recommended. 15-minute data makes more API calls; statistics are always hourly.

backfill_history.name: Backfill history
backfill_history.description: Re-fetch and re-publish a wider window of long-term statistics.

months.name: Months
months.description: How many months of history to refetch (1-84).

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Which Estfeed config entry to backfill.

set_cumulative_reset_at.name: Set cumulative reset_at
set_cumulative_reset_at.description: Move the cumulative-since-reset baseline to a specific timestamp (e.g. to restore a previous anchor). Restores both consumption and production baselines.

reset_at.name: Reset at
reset_at.description: New anchor timestamp. The cumulative sensors will sum intervals from this moment forward.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Which Estfeed config entry to update.
